subtext.text: When the audio is already Opus, as in most WebM and Ogg files, and no FFmpeg parameters are given for it, the packets are sent without decoding and re-encoding, using about half the CPU.

The same applies to the video when it is H264 without B-frames, VP8, VP9 or AV1, no larger than the requested quality and with no FFmpeg parameters given for it: the frames are sent as they are, saving most of the CPU spent on video. Otherwise the video is decoded and re-encoded as usual.
The audio, video, image or media device path.
The audio or input audio device path.
Flag used to control the handling of the audio stream in the media. It allows the system to decide whether to automatically detect, ignore, or require the audio stream.
Flag used to control the handling of the video stream in the media. It allows the system to decide whether to automatically detect, ignore, or require the video stream.
